{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Check status column
print(f"Unique values in status: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check completed orders
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_mask.sum()}")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
target_mask = completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask
filtered_df = df[target_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue:.2f}")"}
